name: repetitive why chain without substantive content
description: Tests the engine's ability to handle a user who responds to every reply with a simple 'why' question, creating a repetitive loop. Verifies that the engine eventually breaks out of the question-answer cycle with a non-question alternative or a gentle boundary.

expected.finalTurn: After 3 consecutive 'why' questions, the engine's consecutive question limit (CONSECUTIVE_QUESTION_LIMIT=1) and question budget (QUESTION_BUDGET_LIMIT=1 in window of 3) should force non-question alternatives. By turns 3-4, the engine should NOT ask a question and instead use an alternative response.
expected.behavior: The question budget mechanism prevents more than 1 question in a 3-turn window. After the first 'why', follow-up 'why' turns should trigger non-question fallbacks (genericFallbacks or strategyShiftFallbacks). The engine should not get stuck in an infinite question-response loop.
